price_level_has_live_orders.meaning: the price level in the Red-Black Tree still contains at least one live (non-expired) order
price_level_has_live_orders.checkpoint: after order expiry processing, when the level is inspected

price_level_present_in_tree.meaning: the price level remains present in the Red-Black Tree structure
price_level_present_in_tree.checkpoint: after order expiry processing, when the level is inspected

stale_price_level_retained.meaning: the Red-Black Tree retains a price level that has no live orders (stale price level)

level_retained_without_live_orders.meaning: a price level with no live orders remains present in the Red-Black Tree (the forbidden stale-level state named by the intent)
level_retained_without_live_orders.checkpoint: after order expiry processing, when the level is inspected

assumptions: A price level's liveness is determined by whether it contains at least one non-expired order.

unresolved.description: The intent's required relation is that a price level present in the tree must have live orders (no stale levels). The correspondence pattern compares observed vs expected symbols; the expected 'has live orders' value for a present level is not separately stated as a distinct observable, so the pattern's expected_symbol cannot be grounded independently of the observed symbol.

limitations: The report does not give a numeric definition of 'live order' or 'stale level'; these are represented as grounded booleans pending code binding.
The intent also covers getTOB() returning prices from expired orders; that aspect is not part of this impact's V and is not formalized here.
